description: Elections Commission - W. K. B. P. S. Fernando of the Beruwala Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of the member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna - W. M. A. K. Senevirathne of the Bandaragama Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of the member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna - H. G. Piyarathna, of the Galenbindunuwewa Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated office of the member of the Sri Lanka Freedom Party
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their office as Members of their respective Pradeshiya Sabhas due to ceasing membership in their political parties. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government bodies, making it clearly fall under Elections Gazettes (Type 7).
